title: Versioned Solution Graph Harness Bundle
description: Self-contained package schema with embedded resources. The trusted runtime separately applies extension-registry payload validation.

api.title: Api
api.description: Closed API request and error envelopes. Reference a named $defs entry, not this library root.

attempt.title: Attempt
attempt.description: Runtime-owned attempt snapshot. A worker cannot authoritatively change its state or fencing token.

common.title: Common
common.description: Reusable closed envelopes and scalar contracts. This library schema is not an API document type.

Extensions.description: Namespaced extension envelopes. Payload validation and behavioral permissions come from the trusted registry.

context.title: Context
context.description: Frozen context manifest. READY requires semantic coverage, permissions, artifact integrity, and budget checks beyond shape validation.

event.title: Event
event.description: Transactional outbox envelope. v1 payload is informational and never independently authorizes an action.

extension-registry.title: Extension Registry
extension-registry.description: Trusted deployment configuration. Registry entries are not accepted from model-generated packages.

node-content.title: Node Content
node-content.description: Model-proposable content. Contains no authority, execution state, actor, revision, or timestamp fields.

node.title: Node
node.description: Immutable node revision assigned by the runtime. Authority and validity live in separate projections.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Effect ledger record created before dispatch. Outcomes require adapter receipts, not model claims.

package.title: Package
package.description: Unified snapshot containing current heads and referenced historical records. Import is a draft proposal; an export never grants authority.

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: Atomic graph mutation proposal. Authentication and acceptance authority never come from this body.

relation-content.title: Relation Content
relation-content.description: Proposable relationship. requires points from dependent task to prerequisite task.

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: Immutable typed relation revision with pinned endpoint revisions.

review-request.title: Review Request
review-request.description: Authorized review request. Actor, tenant, policy, and resulting authority records are server supplied.

risk-extension.title: Risk Extension
risk-extension.description: Example org.acme.delivery_risk annotation payload. Does not change scheduling or approval policy.

skill-invocation.title: Skill Invocation
skill-invocation.description: Runtime-supplied model invocation binding a trusted skill, frozen context, approved route, output contract, and budget.

skill-result.title: Skill Result
skill-result.description: Model response. Outputs remain untrusted proposals and observations until validated by the runtime.

verification-result.title: Verification Result
verification-result.description: Observed verification result for exact criteria, code, and environment. PASS is never inferred from schema conformance.
